# SukuuX Ghana Schools Explorer

> Searchable directory of 10,795 Ghana school records representing 10,503 unique institution IDs across 16 regions and 261 districts.

- Main explorer: https://search.sukuux.com/
- School directory: https://search.sukuux.com/schools/
- Regions: https://search.sukuux.com/regions/
- Districts: https://search.sukuux.com/districts/
- Methodology: https://search.sukuux.com/methodology/
- XML sitemap: https://search.sukuux.com/sitemap.xml

Coordinates generally represent approximate towns or localities, not verified school campuses. Phone numbers and other directory fields should be independently confirmed before consequential use.
